description.en:
Paint crops onto your fields from the build menu, just like painting terrain.
Open the build menu -> Landscaping -> Paint. At the end of the list you find one brush per crop plus "Remove crop".
- Left mouse (hold): paint the crop - Mouse wheel / brush size keys: change brush size - Secondary action: choose growth stage (seeded ... ready to harvest, withered, harvested) - Tertiary action: plant the WHOLE field under the cursor
Only works on land you own and only on field ground.
